main_measure.name: mean of (-forecast/10) x negated excess 3-bar return

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day summed

main_measure.threshold: above 0 with t >= 2 to confirm; below 0 with t <= -2 to reject

supporting_check.name: mean excess 3-bar return, deepest third minus shallowest third

decided_by: The main measure is above 0 with t >= 2 and the supporting check passes.
reading: The deepest third is the n//3 cases with the most negative forecast and the shallowest the n//3 nearest 0; the coin's mean 3-bar return is over all its grid bars in all windows; the t sums each day's deviations from the mean (clustered standard error with G/(G-1) correction); fewer than the minimum cases is 'not observable'.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.005313 on the check folds against +0.007142 on every fold
